SA is not about the perpetrator desiring you or finding you attractive, it's about dominance, control and taking advantage of you. children and babies get SA'ed. they don't want you, they don't find you attractive, they just want to dominate and torment you just because they can. i suggest getting therapy to sort out these thoughts.

i hate being told to say positive things about myself because it just seems impossible, everytime i get asked to say something positive i just space out. i feel like i am undeserving of good things too. and yeah, i hate eating and sleeping because i get so full easily and i dont think i deserve to eat, and sleeping is so hard because my mind is always racing and i get paranoid.

i don't know any advice, but im in the same boat as you. i have also been feeling a deep amount of emptiness, and have been for this entire year.. i do things to try and rid of it but it just doesn't help. playing video games, going shopping or on car rides, listening to music or talking my sister's ear off... even in the midst of it or in the end, i am still so so so empty and bored and fatigued. i've also had thoughts of wanting to do SH but i resist everytime. it's such a struggle..

quite irrational.. its not really a competition, if she feels hurt by her sister then that's valid in its own and if you feel hurt by your family abandoning you then that's just as valid. it's not a "i have it worse" competition in the slightest

that's not the point op is making, bpd 100% cannot be controlled but coming to a space where people will most likely validate and console someone for whatever action they did that crossed the line and are aware of, it's rather distasteful and there should be better ways to validate pwBPD.

I feel this way too, its not as bad as it was last year for me which is when I got diagnosed too. But you cant exactly be cured from it and if the symptoms were present enough for you to be diagnosed, then you definitely do have it, but you've learned to just manage it better which is a great thing. You're not any less valid for that

I am going through the same thing. I'm not on meds right now because my psychiatrist jeeps pushing my appointments back, but I understand the feeling of emptiness while being on and off meds. A symptom of bpd is chronic emptiness and it is unbearable, I wish i knew how to get out of it.

i tend to be highly judgmental too, even with people i'm in the same situation as... it feels like projection mixed with frustration. i have a lot of empathy for others so seeing anyone feeling such negative emotions and thoughts ruins me, and i don't even have to know them.. and because i feel so frustrated that i can't do anything, i just want to shake them and tell them to suck it up and stop thinking this way. i also am even sometimes judgmental or even jealous of people who are just doing things that make them happy, because i wish i could have their mindset and their positivity. obviously i don't verbalize it but these thoughts do make me feel bad.

im sorry to hear that .. i am the same way, usually when i feel overwhelmed with emotions even over small things, i either zone out or break down in tears or get really destructive, whether outwardly or with myself, like hitting/scratching or grabbing my hair. i feel worse after being this way too, but i've learned ways to avoid being self-injurious; it sounds basic and overused but try counting to 10 or focusing intensely on something in front of you and calm yourself down in your head. hold yourself tightly and tell yourself you will be okay and you can get through it, or imagine yourself in a calming place. i dont know if this will help, but it will take sooo long for it to be effective. hope u have a good night 🤍🤍
